gloss: cold-weather gear; winter clothing and accessories

definitions.gloss: cold-weather gear; winter clothing and accessories
definitions.explanation: Clothing, accessories, and equipment designed to protect the body from cold. Includes items such as coats, gloves, scarves, earmuffs, and thermal underwear.

examples.japanese: {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget to bring your cold-weather gear.

examples.japanese: {冬山|ふゆやま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。

examples.english: The temperature dropped suddenly, so I hurried out to buy cold-weather gear.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防寒|ぼうかん}→防寒：17388_boukan⟧ (protection from cold) and ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (tool, equipment). A collective term for any items used to keep warm in cold weather, ranging from everyday winter clothing to specialized mountaineering equipment.

The ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ suffix indicates tools or equipment, so {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ} has a slightly more functional nuance than ⟦{防寒着|ぼうかんぎ}→防寒着：20243_boukangi⟧ (cold-weather clothing), which refers specifically to garments. {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ} can include non-clothing items like hand warmers or blankets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to put on cold-weather gear
- {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare cold-weather gear
- {防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to get a full set of cold-weather gear
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{防寒具|ぼうかんぐ}: adequate cold-weather gear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防寒着|ぼうかんぎ}→防寒着：20243_boukangi⟧: cold-weather clothing — specifically garments, not equipment in general
- ⟦{冬物|ふゆもの}→冬物：27498_fuyumono⟧: winter items — broader term for winter goods including clothing and accessories
- ⟦{防寒|ぼうかん}→防寒：17388_boukan⟧: cold protection — the concept itself, not the physical items
